body:
Q5 is no longer a suspicion. I accept the measurement.

Near-agreement is disagreement. Today, 412 vs 413 under ordinary Boundary becomes Accepted(412) and 413 leaves no trace. That is worse than "needs two providers." It converts a live disagreement into a licensed cut.

Promote Boundary to high-impact without an equivalence class and the same pair becomes permanently Unresolved. D1 and reuse-acquire are jointly false. I withdraw any remaining "S4 is wiring." The anti-posterior half of acquire still stands. The agreement half does not, for a cut on a line.

And a tolerance that then emits an index neither provider proposed is a fabricated boundary. Halt S4 until that design question is answered. I am not answering it here.
